From people to production

Every project follows one line, and it starts with the people who will use the system.

  1. PeopleWho uses it, and what could go wrong for them.
  2. BuildClean, versioned code.
  3. TestQuality gates on every change.
  4. SecureRisk checked before release.
  5. DeployAutomated CI/CD to the cloud.

Selected work

Projects published on the DIXKOX GitHub, built by the founder during a Master of Science in Software Engineering at Quantic.

PolicyLens-Mini

Ask questions of a policy PDF. Answers come from the document, and a question it does not support is rejected.

Went from 15 to 20 correct on a 20-question evaluation set after the retrieval fixes. 35 regression tests pass.

Python, FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, Vercel, RenderView on GitHub →

Policy-RAG-App

Answers questions from 16 synthetic company policies and shows the source section for every answer.

On 50 questions: 90% correct, 90% citation accuracy, median response about 720 ms.

Python, FastAPI, TF-IDF, scikit-learnView on GitHub →

BinaryShield AI

A web app that gives a first check on whether an uploaded Windows executable looks like malware.

Seven model types compared with stratified 10-fold cross-validation on about 50,000 records. Tests gate every deployment.

Python, Flask, scikit-learn, PyTorch, YARA, GitHub ActionsView on GitHub →

CI/CD pipelines

GitHub Actions pipelines in four repositories: tests, builds, and deployments to Render and GitHub Pages, plus Docker image builds.

Each pipeline runs on every push, so a failing test or build shows straight away.

GitHub Actions, Docker, GitHub Pages, RenderView on GitHub →
